meaning: A phone feature that shares its internet connection with a laptop or tablet nearby. It uses your phone's mobile data.
clues: It shares something from your phone with a device nearby.
What it shares is your internet, so a laptop can get online.
Your phone acts like a small home network. Other devices join it and enter a password.
It uses your data and your battery, so it is best to turn it off when you are done.
It has two words. The first means it moves around with you, and the second starts with H.
assumes: Data roaming is using another company's network away from home
Call forwarding sends calls to another number
Screen mirroring shows your screen on a bigger display

decoys.meaning: Using another company's network for your phone data when you are away from home.
A feature that sends your calls to a different phone number.
Showing what is on your phone screen on a TV or computer.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, getting online meant plugging a cord into the wall. Now you carry the wall in your pocket?

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: give your hotspot a password and turn it off when you finish. It saves your data and your battery.
